description: This file defines a mock class 'EventThreadFactoryMock' implementing the 'IEventThreadFactory' interface, used for unit testing within the 'firebolt::rialto::common' namespace. It includes a mock method 'createEventThread' that returns a unique pointer to an 'IEventThread' object, and references external headers 'IEventThread.h' and gmock.
